title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

"Automated speed enforcement system" means a device, or combination of devices, used for traffic enforcement pursuant to section 291C-108, that includes a vehicle sensor working in conjunction and synchronization with a speed measuring device and camera, to automatically produce and record one or more sequenced photographs, microphotographs, video, or other recorded images of a motor vehicle and motor vehicle license plate, at the time the motor vehicle is exceeding the applicable maximum speed limit, in violation of section 291C-108.

"Department" means the department of transportation.

"Motor vehicle" has the same meaning as defined in section 291C-1.

"Owner" or "registered owner" has the same meaning as defined in section 286-2.

[§291L-1]  Definitions.  As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

     "Automated speed enforcement system" means a device, or combination of devices, used for traffic enforcement pursuant to section 291C-108, that includes a vehicle sensor working in conjunction and synchronization with a speed measuring device and camera, to automatically produce and record one or more sequenced photographs, microphotographs, video, or other recorded images of a motor vehicle and motor vehicle license plate, at the time the motor vehicle is exceeding the applicable maximum speed limit, in violation of section 291C-108.

     "Department" means the department of transportation.

     "Motor vehicle" has the same meaning as defined in section 291C-1.

     "Owner" or "registered owner" has the same meaning as defined in section 286-2. [L 2024, c 112, pt of §2]
